cure_period_in_days.description: Days a member can keep failing this check up before being retired. When absent, the default of its importance level applies. 0 means the check up has to pass at all times. A negative value (by convention, -1) is an infinite cure period: the check up stays pending, but it never retires the project.

Default cure period for the check ups of this importance, in days, used for every check up that does not state its own. 0 means the check up has to pass at all times. A negative value (by convention, -1) is an infinite cure period: the check up stays pending, but it never retires the project.
